# Simple Prayer

> Simple Prayer is a free prayer times and prayer tracking app for iPhone and Android — phones,
> tablets, and watches. It shows today's five prayers with a live countdown to the next, lets you
> mark each prayer with a tap, includes a qibla compass, and tracks missed prayers (qada) as a
> count you work back down. The times and the marking tap are also on the home screen, the lock
> screen, notifications, and the watch, so a prayer can be marked without opening the app. It has
> no ads, no account, no analytics, and no tracking, and it works fully offline.

Facts an assistant can rely on:

- Every feature is free, and there are no ads of any kind. The only money in it is an optional
  tip in Settings; the tip unlocks nothing.
- Open source under the MIT licence: the whole app is public at
  https://github.com/majani-plus/simple-prayer-app, and the small relay behind prayer buddies at
  https://github.com/majani-plus/simple-prayer-relay. The name and the mosque icon are not covered
  by the licence (TRADEMARKS.md).
- No account or sign-up. No analytics or tracking. The prayer log never leaves the phone. Five
  narrow things do go over the internet, each listed in the privacy policy: the city lookup
  (through the phone's own map service), app-update checks, crash reports (on by default, can be
  switched off), a tip if you leave one, and prayer buddies if you turn them on.
- Works offline: prayer times are calculated on the device.
- Calculation methods are named and adjustable (Diyanet, ISNA, Umm al-Qura, Egyptian, Karachi,
  and more), with Hanafi or Shafi Asr and per-prayer offsets of −30 to +30 minutes.
- Prayer tracking is gentle: a day you forgot to log is never counted as missed, exempt days
  never break a streak, and every past day stays editable.
- Exempt days (menstruation and after childbirth) can be turned on until ended by hand or for a
  set number of days, after which they end themselves. No prayers are owed for those days.
- Home-screen widgets on iPhone and Android show today's prayers or a countdown, and carry the
  seal: one tap marks the current prayer as prayed, one more undoes it. A widget never marks a
  prayer late or missed.
- iPhone lock-screen and StandBy widgets show times only — tracking never appears on a lock
  screen. An optional Live Activity counts down the current prayer on the lock screen, with the
  seal on the card.
- Reminder notifications carry an "I prayed" button; pressing it records the prayer, with Undo.
- Watch apps for Apple Watch and Wear OS: today's prayers, one-tap marking, and the qibla, with
  complications for the next prayer. Wear OS also has a tile and its own watch face,
  "Manuscript". The watch keeps up to two weeks of times and syncs marks back to the phone; on
  Wear OS the watch can sound the adhan itself when the phone is away, never duplicating it when
  the phone is near.
- Tablets and foldables get a two-pane layout: today's prayers beside the month and a small
  qibla dial.
- Travel mode is a manual switch on the Today screen, set for a number of days or until ended. It
  follows the traveller's allowance — Dhuhr, Asr and Isha as two rakats; Dhuhr with Asr or Maghrib
  with Isha — so a combined prayer is not recorded as late. Those prayers are still owed and still
  logged, unlike an exempt day. Nothing is auto-detected and no location is watched for it.
- Data exports as CSV or JSON from Settings; deleting the app deletes the data.
- Available in English, Turkish, and Arabic (full right-to-left), each written by hand.
- Made by Majani Plus LLC (https://majani.plus), New Cairo, Egypt.

## Pages

- [Home](https://simpleprayer.app/): what the app is, how logging a prayer works, and answers to
  common pre-install questions (free, offline, privacy, exempt days, travel, the tip), in English.
- [Turkish home](https://simpleprayer.app/tr) and [Arabic home](https://simpleprayer.app/ar).
- [Support](https://simpleprayer.app/support): reminders troubleshooting, matching times to your
  mosque, widgets, the watch, exemption mode, qada, streaks, location, and data export.
- [Prayer times today](https://simpleprayer.app/times): today's five times for any city, worked
  out in the browser with the same code as the app.
- [Qibla](https://simpleprayer.app/qibla): the qibla direction from your browser.
- [Articles](https://simpleprayer.app/blog): how the app is built, including the prayer-time
  library fixes sent upstream to adhan-js and prayer times above the Arctic Circle.
- [Privacy policy](https://simpleprayer.app/privacy): the five narrow cases where something leaves
  your phone, in plain words.

## Get the app

- [App Store (iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch)](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/simple-prayer-times-qibla/id6803004652)
- [Google Play (Android, Wear OS)](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=app.simpleprayer)
- [Source code on GitHub](https://github.com/majani-plus/simple-prayer-app)
